annotations.title: Full location pack for a listing

description: Everything for one address in one call: drive times to the nearest town, cities and airports; people living within a 1, 2 and 4 hour drive (US Census 2020 or WorldPop 2020 UK); nearby lakes, rivers, coast, mountains, national parks and attractions with distances and drive minutes; waterfront and inside-a-national-park checks; the mapped site outline and its size in acres and hectares; and map links (US aerial photo). Returns listing_lines (short sentences to paste into a listing), the raw numbers, and sources with licences. Takes 10 to 25 seconds.

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

destinations.description: Optional extra places to time, as names ("Albany, NY") or {name, lat, lon}. Up to 6.

hours.description: Drive bands in hours for the people count. Default [1, 2, 4]. Up to 4 bands, each 0.25 to 5.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).

radius_miles.description: How far to look for nature and attractions. Default 20, max 40.
